about: Tobler's go-to global services. Two kinds: services Tobler calls directly (because the atlas doesn't hold them, or holds only a copy with a worse licence), and trusted publishers whose own atlas records are ranked first. Edit by hand; each entry says where its licence comes from. Started 17 Nov 2026.

services.title: Active fires and thermal hotspots, VIIRS 375 m (NASA FIRMS)
services.licence: Free and open under NASA's Earth science data policy; cite NASA FIRMS
services.attribution: NASA FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System), VIIRS 375 m active fire product (S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21)
services.note: Satellite detections of heat, at about 375 m: fires, gas flares, industrial heat. Positions are pixel centres. Shows what was detected in the days asked (up to 5, NASA's limit), not a long record.

services.title: Active fires and thermal hotspots, MODIS 1 km (NASA FIRMS)
services.licence: Free and open under NASA's Earth science data policy; cite NASA FIRMS
services.attribution: NASA FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System), MODIS Collection 6.1 active fire product
services.note: Coarser (1 km) than VIIRS; the longer-running record. Use VIIRS first.

publishers.about: Atlas records whose publisher matches one of these are marked trusted and ranked first. National and intergovernmental bodies with a global or regional remit; national mapping and environment agencies are already ranked first by publisher type.

values_about: Raster services the screening checks read values from (catalogue/checks.json: topo.elevation, topo.water-depth, material.vessel-traffic) (js/elevation.js, js/seavalues.js): elevation (shown as water depth at sea) and AIS vessel traffic. Called directly from the page (both send CORS headers). Added 19 Nov 2026; to be swapped for atlas records once the atlas tags value-returning services (request in docs/atlas-requests.md).

values.about_elevation: Elevation sources, finest first. Every value is turned into metres positive up (js/elevation.js) using each source's sign (up: values are elevations; down: values are depths), units and vertical datum. Water depth is shown as -elevation at sea. Since 24 Nov: national lidar first (England 1 m, US 3DEP), then EMODnet bathymetry at sea, then NOAA's global mosaic. Each source has `where` (the box it covers) and `serves` (land, sea, or both when absent); a source with no value at a place falls through to the next. resolution_units: m where the service reports cell size in metres.

elevation.title: LIDAR Composite DTM 1 m, 2022 (Environment Agency)
elevation.vertical_datum: Ordnance Datum Newlyn (heights above mean sea level at Newlyn)
elevation.attribution: © Environment Agency copyright and/or database right 2022. All rights reserved.
elevation.coverage: about 99% of England, bare earth (DTM), 1 m
elevation.note: Added 24 Nov 2026 (Rob: lidar where it exists). Lidar gaps answer no value and fall through to the global model. Not yet read live from the page (CORS to check).

elevation.title: 3DEP Bare Earth DEM (USGS 3D Elevation Program)
elevation.coverage: United States, mostly lidar at 1 m, coarser where lidar isn't yet flown
elevation.note: Added 24 Nov 2026. Not yet read live from the page (CORS to check).

elevation.title: EMODnet Bathymetry (European Environment Agency image service)
elevation.vertical_datum: not stated on the service; EMODnet's DTM is referenced to Lowest Astronomical Tide (LAT)
elevation.licence: EEA re-use policy and EMODnet (CC BY 4.0): re-use with attribution
elevation.attribution: © European Environment Agency; EMODnet Bathymetry Consortium
elevation.note: Added 24 Nov 2026 (Rob: bathymetry). Values are elevations (min -6809, max 950 on the service), so sign up. Not yet read live from the page (CORS to check).

elevation.title: DEM Global Mosaic (bathymetry and topography)
elevation.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
elevation.vertical_datum: mostly EGM2008 (ETOPO 2022); some coastal DEMs use tidal datums such as MHHW
elevation.licence: US federal government data (NOAA NCEI): public domain in the US (inferred; not stated on the service). Built from GEBCO and other sources, which keep their own attribution
elevation.licence_source: inferred: US federal work (17 U.S.C. §105); the service description gives no licence
elevation.attribution: NOAA NCEI DEM Global Mosaic (ETOPO 2022; includes GEBCO Compilation Group data)
elevation.note: Land and open ocean from ETOPO 2022 at 15 arc-seconds (about 460 m); finer coastal and survey DEMs where NOAA holds them (mostly US). Checked 20 Nov: Linlithgow 109 m, Zermatt area 3,553 m, central North Sea -90 m.

traffic.title: Vessel Density, annual averages (EMODnet Human Activities)
traffic.publisher: EMODnet Human Activities (Cogea Srl), from AIS by CLS, ORBCOMM and vesseltracker.com
traffic.attribution: EMODnet Human Activities, Vessel Density (Cogea Srl), AIS data from CLS, ORBCOMM and vesseltracker.com
traffic.coverage_note: EMODnet's vessel density covers EU waters and neighbouring seas only
traffic.note: Hours spent by vessels per km² a month, 1 km cells. 2023 is used: EMODnet notes 2024 lost satellite AIS data from June.
